sourceText:
Orzo Pilaf
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 12:16am

Ingredients




1 tablespoon butter or margarine * orig was 2T
1 cup orzo (about 6 oz.)
uncooked
2 tablespoons finely chopped onion
cup hot water
2 chicken bouillon cubes Chopped fresh parsley (optional)

Preparation

1 * (I used only 1 T and it was fine - might even try 1/2 T) 2 In 10-inch non-stick skillet over medium-high, melt butter, stir in uncooked orzo and onion. Cook, stirring frequently until orzo is lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Stir in hot water and bouillon; heat to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover; simmer 12 minutes or until most liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally. Garnish with parsley. If desired 4 serving (1/2 cup each). 3 Vegetable Pilaf: During the last 6 minutes of cooking stir in your choice of 1/2 cup frozen peas (thawed and drained) or diced sweet red pepper or 1 cup thinly sliced mushrooms.
